verdict.rationale: Pydantic AI has built-in, optional Logfire instrumentation that creates a trace per agent run, with a span for each model request and each tool call. Logfire is the same team's observability platform, and its docs say it records model calls and tool calls in one trace, which delivers the story's observability UI. Missing for 10: independent hands-on corroboration of the trace view in the UI (Logfire is also a separate optional product that must be installed and configured).

support.subject: As a developer, I can trace every LLM call and tool invocation of an agent run in an observability UI

citations.quote: A trace is generated for the agent run, and spans are emitted for each model request and tool call.

Pydantic AI has built-in (but optional) support for Logfire. That means if the logfire package is installed and configured and agent instrumentation is enabled then detailed information about agent runs is sent to Logfire.
Pydantic Logfire is an observability platform developed by the team who created and maintain Pydantic Validation and Pydantic AI.
Instrument the libraries around an agent to record its model calls, tool calls, HTTP requests and database queries in one trace
